verdict_rationale: Real, identified, funded-offtake project, currently pre-construction at the solar array with a confirmed contractual schedule slip. Developer chain fully resolved: Duffy Project Co LLC (f/k/a VDA Solar Texas 1, LLC) is Linea Energy's project vehicle (TX Comptroller franchise-tax record + Linea's own May-2026 press release); Google signed a 15-year, 500 MW PPA off this project (sources/2026-07-20_lineaenergy_official-500mw-ppa-announcement.html), corroborated independently by Bay City Tribune local news (2026-06-23). Interconnection is CONFIRMED via 3 signed IA documents (original SGIA + Amendment One + Amendment Two, INR '23INR0057' printed in each) -- and the IA's own most recent amendment has already moved the CONTRACTUAL scheduled COD to 2028-10-31 (Amendment Two, effective 2026-07-03), 10 months past the queue's still-reported 2027-12-31 and also later than Linea/local-news public messaging of a 'late 2027' target -- a three-way COD disagreement (queue vs. signed IA vs. developer PR) that is itself the most decisive drift signal in this file. Co-located Duffy BESS (235 MWac) is independently confirmed under active construction via EIA-860M + active TCEQ storm NOIs, and a tight satellite chip centered exactly on the IA POI shows a small pad consistent with that BESS, stable between 2026-01 and 2026-07. The broader 3,526-acre solar array shows no grading/racking signature yet in either frame, consistent with the developer's own 'construction begins Q3 2026' timeline.

rationale: PRIMARY EVIDENCE, most authoritative: signed Amendment Two (effective 2026-07-03, filed 3 weeks before this research) sets the contractual scheduled COD at 'later of 10/31/2028 or 4 months after TIF In-Service Date' -- 10 months later than the queue's still-reported 2027-12-31 and later than Amendment One's schedule. The queue snapshot has not caught up to this amendment.

SECONDARY, developer-stated target: Linea Energy's own PR (2026-05) and Bay City Tribune (2026-06-23) both describe construction 'beginning Q3 2026' with 'commercial operations targeted for late 2027' -- a THIRD, more optimistic date than either the queue or the signed IA. Independent estimate below weights the signed contractual document over developer messaging, per playbook (claims to verify, not evidence), but records the gap: developer PR is ~10 months ahead of the IA's own legal schedule, which the developer itself co-signed 3 weeks before the PR reiterated 'late 2027.'

This is the IA's 4th schedule (2025-08-06 orig -> 2027-12-31 Amendment One -> 2028-10-31 Amendment Two), a real amendment cadence of ~1 slip every 9-14 months, distinct from but consistent with the queue's own 3-change history

TIF In-Service Date prerequisite items are due 2027-04-15 per Amendment Two -- unchanged from Amendment One -- meaning the COD slip happened on the back-end math, not because an early milestone changed
Offtake is secured (Google 15-yr 500 MW PPA) and financing is at least partly de-risked by that PPA -- reduces (but does not eliminate) execution risk relative to a project with no signed offtake

Co-located 235 MWac Duffy BESS independently confirmed under active construction (EIA-860M + active TCEQ storm NOIs, EPC IEA Constructors) -- substation-area civil work is underway, though this does not confirm the solar array itself has broken ground

Ownership change (VDA Solar Texas 1 -> Duffy Project Co LLC, i.e. the Linea Energy acquisition) between 2023 and Oct-2025, plus an inverter-vendor swap (Sungrow -> Power Electronics) and capacity trim (540->502.46 MW), plausibly explains why the schedule reset rather than signaling distress

Independent estimate splits the difference conservatively toward the signed IA: 2028-Q4 (Amendment Two's 10/31/2028, taken at face value) -- if the developer's public Q3-2026-start / late-2027-COD claim proves accurate instead, that would represent a POSITIVE surprise versus this estimate, not further slippage
